name: Laser-cut sheet stock: actual thickness of nominal 3 mm and 6 mm plywood, acrylic and MDF
notes: What fab.sheet_actual() and fab.slot_width() use. Nominal '6 mm' / 1/4 in plywood is sold thin: US 1/4 in ply is 7/32 in (5.56 mm) actual, Baltic birch 6 mm is +0.4/-0.5 mm, and makers report 0.21-0.27 in across brands, so 5.5 mm is the typical stock; US 1/4 in acrylic is sold as 5.5 mm (0.217 in). MDF holds +/-0.15 mm. The shop should caliper each new batch and update this entry.
